_doc: 3.80.R, fixed before the first run. R-A is the service's prompts, verbatim: tools.jetson.bench_identity_llama.PROMPT (identity) and service.local_vlm.driver.DIRECTION_PROMPT (direction). R-N is each model's native grounding call, from its model card; native[<backend>][<skill>] is the text sent, {target} the walk's target name. PaliGemma 2's 'detect {target}' is listed but blocked (gated repo).
